title: Sparkle
blurb: Glittering chimes, layered thick — the sound design equivalent of glitter itself, and about as easy to remove once applied. Sparkle stings come out of cartoon and advertising libraries where they signal magic, cleanliness or transformation, which is why they turn up equally in fairy-tale animation and adverts for bathroom cleaner. Online the same clip has been thoroughly repurposed for irony: lay it over something deeply unglamorous and the contrast does the joke by itself. Straight uses still work perfectly, especially over a reveal or a before-and-after cut.
origin: A shimmering magical sparkle sound effect.
